blocks.prompt: 9. The Governor of the Punjab calls a meeting of 14 officers. In how many ways can they be seated at a round table?
blocks.explanation:
14 officers gol table par bethein ge, koi aur shart nahi. Yeh seedha circular permutation hai.
Plan: ek officer ko fix karein aur baaqi 13 ko arrange karein (Case-I).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 14 officers, round table.
Humein find karna hai: 14 officers ke gol table par bethne ke kul tareeqe.
Tareeqa: \(n\) mukhtalif log gol table par \((n - 1)!\) tareeqon se beth sakte hain. Meeting mein clockwise aur anticlockwise tarteeb alag hoti hai (daayen aur baayen wala farq hai), is liye Case-I lagta hai.

Formula lagayen
\[(14 - 1)! = 13!\]
Kyun: Sab officers ek seat aage khisak jayen to har ek ke parosi wahi rehte hain, yani tarteeb nahi badli. Is liye ek officer ko fix kar ke baaqi 13 ko arrange karte hain. Fix officer ke baad pehli khaali seat ke 13, agli ke 12, ... tareeqe hain.
Dhyan dein: \(14!\) likhna seedhi line ka jawab hai, gol table ka nahi.

\(13!\) nikaalein
\[13! = 13 \times 12 \times 11!\]
\[= 156 \times 39916800\]
\[= 6227020800\]
Kyun: \(11! = 39916800\) humein Sawal 1(iii) mein mila tha; upar sirf \(13 \times 12 = 156\) multiply karna para.

Tasdeeq
\[14! \div 14 = \dfrac{87178291200}{14}\]
\[= 6227020800 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Line ki 14! tarteebon mein har gol tarteeb 14 dafa aati hai, is liye 14 se divide kar ke wohi jawab mila. Kitab ka jawab sirf 14 officers ko ginta hai; agar Governor bhi table par bethein to 15 log hon ge aur jawab 14! hoga.
